dedupe_keys.name: warwick lithium battery ageing and impedance state of health tests

description: The DIB_Data deposit contains controlled battery ageing and electrochemical impedance tests produced by WMG at the University of Warwick. The article documents twenty-five initially unused cylindrical cells cycled toward five state-of-health breakpoints, with reference capacity tests and impedance measurements at several states of charge and temperatures. A public archive and accompanying table provide the training and validation material; the article identifies CSV cycler outputs and XLSX impedance data. Mendeley version 3 applies CC0 1.0, with free access. Coverage is limited to a laboratory campaign in Coventry, not an operational storage fleet or continuous calendar series. The reported 360 impedance files should not be interpreted as a complete factorial experiment across every cell, temperature and state. A reviewer-assessed use is calibrating battery degradation or state-estimation components in storage simulations. model-system-advisor-model-sam is a related project-level battery resource. The archive and model-training calculations were not downloaded or executed.
